from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,capstone
from snail import match as m
from snail.symbols import load_function_symbol_manifest
out=Path('/tmp/snail-goal-encoded');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
evidence=json.loads(Path('analysis/progress/win32-reflexive.json').read_text());names=[r['name'] for r in evidence['functions'] if r['matched'] and not r['body_byte_exact']]
manifest=load_function_symbol_manifest(Path('analysis/symbols/gameplay-functions.json'));image=m.load_image(Path(manifest.primary_target),manifest.image_base)
md=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86,capstone.CS_MODE_32);md.detail=True
rows=[]
for name in names:
 c=m.load_scratch_config(Path('tools/match/scratches',name));r=[];st=m.scratch_status_payload(m.evaluate_scratch(c,on_match=r.append));result=r[0]
 obj=m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(m.compile_scratch(c,m.DEFAULT_MATCH_ROOT).read_bytes()),c.symbol or c.function)
 start,end=m.resolve_function_extent(manifest,c.function,c.end_va);target=image.function_bytes(start,end);diffs=[]
 assert result.exact and not result.body_byte_exact
 for index,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(result.target_disassembly,result.candidate_disassembly)):
  left=bytearray(target[a.offset:a.offset+a.size]);right=bytearray(obj.data[b.offset:b.offset+b.size])
  if m._is_inline_data(a):continue
  ta=next(md.disasm(bytes(left),a.offset));cb=next(md.disasm(bytes(right),b.offset))
  for ref in b.masked_references:
   if ref.source!='reloc':continue
   field='imm' if ref.kind=='imm' else 'disp';offset=getattr(cb,field+'_offset');size=getattr(cb,field+'_size')
   assert offset==getattr(ta,field+'_offset') and size==getattr(ta,field+'_size')
   left[offset:offset+size]=right[offset:offset+size]=bytes(size)
  local=m._local_branch_offsets(b)
  if local and b.offset+cb.imm_offset in obj.relocation_offsets:
   assert len(local)==1;size=cb.imm_size;right[cb.imm_offset:cb.imm_offset+size]=((local[0]-b.offset-b.size)%(1<<(8*size))).to_bytes(size,'little')
  if left!=right or a.offset!=b.offset:
   diffs.append({'index':index,'native_address':start+a.offset,'target_offset':a.offset,'candidate_offset':b.offset,'normalized_target':a.text,'normalized_candidate':b.text,'native_raw':target[a.offset:a.offset+a.size].hex(),'candidate_raw':obj.data[b.offset:b.offset+b.size].hex(),'audited_native':left.hex(),'audited_candidate':right.hex(),'native_decode':ta.mnemonic+' '+ta.op_str,'candidate_decode':cb.mnemonic+' '+cb.op_str})
 row={'function':name,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((c.directory/'scratch.cpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'status':st,'encoded_differences':diffs,'audit':m._masked_audit_cache_payload(result.masked_operand_audit)};rows.append(row)
 print(name,len(diffs),[(hex(x['target_offset']),x['native_decode'],x['candidate_decode'],x['audited_native'],x['audited_candidate']) for x in diffs][:12],flush=True)
 (out/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import json,dataclasses,hashlib,pefile
from snail import match as m
out=Path('/tmp/snail-goal-encoded');rows=[];identities=[]
for compiler in ['msvc6.0','msvc6.3','msvc6.5']:
 files=[]
 for name in ['CL.EXE','C1XX.DLL','C2.DLL']:
  p=m.DEFAULT_MATCH_ROOT/'compilers'/compiler/'Bin'/name;raw=p.read_bytes();pe=pefile.PE(data=raw,fast_load=False);v=pe.VS_FIXEDFILEINFO[0];ms,ls=v.FileVersionMS,v.FileVersionLS
  files.append({'file':name,'version':[ms>>16,ms&65535,ls>>16,ls&65535],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
 identities.append({'compiler':compiler,'files':files})
 for name in ['load_builtin_segment_definitions','calc_object_texture_groups','initialize_track_render_cache_manager']:
  c=m.load_scratch_config(Path('tools/match/scratches',name));source=(c.directory/'scratch.cpp').read_text();r=[]
  st=m.scratch_status_payload(m.evaluate_source_overlay(dataclasses.replace(c,compiler=compiler),source,on_match=r.append))
  rows.append({'compiler_profile':compiler,'function':name,'status':st})
  print(compiler,name,st['match_ratio'],st['candidate_instructions'],st['body_byte_exact'],st['references'],st['error'],flush=True)
  (out/'compiler-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps({'compiler_identities':identities,'results':rows},indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace,asdict
import json,hashlib,capstone
from snail import match as m
out=Path('/tmp/snail-goal-subgame');c=m.load_scratch_config(Path('tools/match/scratches/update_subgame'));results=[];objects={}
md=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86,capstone.CS_MODE_32)
for label in ['baseline','literal-all','literal-one','literal-zero','const-all']:
 d=out/('compile-'+label);d.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(d/'scratch.cpp').write_text(m.scratch_compilation_source(c,m.DEFAULT_MATCH_ROOT,source_text=(out/(label+'.cpp')).read_text()));(d/'scratch.conf').write_text((c.directory/'scratch.conf').read_text());config=replace(c,directory=d)
 obj=m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(m.compile_scratch(config,m.DEFAULT_MATCH_ROOT).read_bytes()),c.symbol);objects[label]=obj
 before=objects['baseline'];different=[]
 for a,b in zip(md.disasm(before.data,0),md.disasm(obj.data,0)):
  if a.bytes!=b.bytes:different.append({'offset':a.address,'before':a.bytes.hex(),'after':b.bytes.hex(),'before_decode':a.mnemonic+' '+a.op_str,'after_decode':b.mnemonic+' '+b.op_str})
 results.append({'label':label,'code_sha256':m.object_function_fingerprint(obj),'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(obj.data).hexdigest(),'relocations':[asdict(x) for x in obj.relocation_references],'different':different});print(label,len(different),different[:12])
(out/'byte-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2,default=lambda x: sorted(x) if isinstance(x,frozenset) else x.hex())+'\n')
